Coram : TARUN CHATTERJEE, H.L. DATTU
Service law - Retiral benefits - Claim of - Conviction order against employee under the provisions of Penal Code c - Termination of service during pendency of appeal - Thereafter, death of employee - Subsequently order of acquittal passed - Representation by employee's wife seeking of - Writ petition seeking monetary and service benefits as also interim application D seeking quashing of termination order - Dismissal of - LPA also dismissed - On appeal, held: Order of High Court not justified - Employee was dismissed on basis of conviction order - No departmental enquiry
Decision Date : 14-05-2009 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 3564/2009 | Disposal Nature : Appeal(s) allowed | Bench : 2 Judges
